title: Mixed7 Trio #04 (금박+바디페인팅+UV네온)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Gold Leaf track): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — full body applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Thin irregular metallic sheets — BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points, a soft warm metallic sheen filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed. Footwear: platform boots 8 inch, extra long stiletto nails to match.

#2 (Bodypaint track): a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, gyaru-style tan skin, heavy false lashes, glittery eyeshadow, glossy pale lip, cool and composed, high ponytail hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, chrome finish. An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Painted in Islamic geometric star-tile pattern (a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars), wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip. Footwear: extreme gold extreme platform buckled boots.

#3 (UV Neon track): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, UV-reactive BLAZING silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — full body UV neon lightning web bodypaint covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Bold formations — BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD lightning bolt formations branching across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID NEON YELLOW spark burst formations filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: full frontal wide stance, both fists pressing outer hips outward to absolute maximum — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed. Under her own dedicated UV blacklight spot, zero white light reaching her specifically. Footwear: platform boots 8 inch, extra long stiletto nails BLAZING NEON UV reactive tips.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 3, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio.
